# Antigravity plugin.json vocabulary, verified against `agy plugin validate`.
# Verified host version: agy 1.1.10 (2026-08-04).
#
# `component` = a key the host resolves into a loadable component.
# `metadata`  = a key the host carries but does not act on.
#
# Anything NOT listed here is DROPPED BY THE HOST WITHOUT A WARNING. That is how
# `rules` and `workflows` shipped inert while every internal-consistency test
# stayed green. Re-verify this list on every agy upgrade — a retired key is just
# as damaging as an unknown one, and no test here can detect that on its own.
component skills
component agents
component commands
component mcpServers
component hooks
metadata name
metadata version
metadata description
metadata author
metadata repository
metadata license
metadata keywords
